x: The APPSC Group-II 2025 key gives 'Abhinava Nannaya' to Viswanatha Satyanarayana (also 'Kavi Samrat'). Duvvuri Ramireddy = Kavi Kokila; Devulapalli Krishna Sastri = Andhra Shelley; Gurajada = father of modern Telugu literature.
